what: doublegate's API as data — rendered from the code that serves it, checked against it in the code repositories' CI, published here as a snapshot

mcp-tools.json.about: the tool schemas of the gate's built-in plugin, which is retiring, as its tools/list answers them; the Claude Code plugin's tools are not in this file

daemon-rpc.json.about: every verb on the gate's local socket: parameters, role, the proof each needs; a running gate answers the same to dg.describe

openapi.json.about: OpenAPI for the gate's HTTP surface on this machine; it answers on loopback only, with a sign-in or an API key

note.schema.json.about: JSON Schema of a note's data, which the notifier peer publishes — the closed field set a subscriber or a knowledge map may rely on
